ambiguities.fragment: shall contain all granted and denied admittances
ambiguities.explanation: The requirement is ambiguous because it does not specify whether 'granted' refers to successful entries that complied with security protocols or simply any entry, including those which were subsequently rejected.
possible_interpretations: The report includes only the instances where individuals have been granted access and allowed into the building.
The report lists all attempts at admittance without distinction between grants of permission (successful) versus denials due to security checks or other reasons.
